label: LED Bar (Horizontal)
author: Conky-Studio
description: Segmented LED-style horizontal meter with optional heat colours per segment.
lua_draw_body:
local n = math.floor({segments} + 0.5)
 local gap = {gap}
 local total_gap = gap * (n - 1)
 local seg_w = ({width} - total_gap) / n
 local min_v, max_v = {min_value}, {max_value}
 local span = max_v - min_v; if span == 0 then span = 1 end
 local pct = ((tonumber({value}) or min_v) - min_v) / span
 if pct < 0 then pct = 0 elseif pct > 1 then pct = 1 end
 local lit = pct * n
 local fr, fg, fb = {color}
 local tr, tg, tb = {track_color}
 for i = 0, n - 1 do
  local bx = {x} + i * (seg_w + gap)
  local on = (i + 1) <= lit or (i < lit)
  local bright = 1
  if i < lit and i + 1 > lit then bright = lit - i end
  if on or bright > 0 then
   if {heat_map} and studio_heat_rgb then
    fr, fg, fb = studio_heat_rgb((i + 0.5) / n)
   end
   cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, fr, fg, fb, {opacity} * math.max(bright, on and 1 or 0))
  else
   cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tr, tg, tb, {opacity} * 0.65)
  end
  cairo_rectangle(cr, bx, {y}, seg_w, {height})
  cairo_fill(cr)
 end
